subject: CRPS-PAIRED: kill Δ≥0.5 at n≥272; synthetic meanD 0.012 SE 0.014, Gaussian not killed; TeamGameLog missing
body:
SHA after push. Unit 3 of 4.

KILL, PRE-REGISTERED BEFORE LOOKING. Gaussian is killed as a substitute for discrete CRPS iff nLicensed ≥ 272 and mean_i [CRPS_N(μ_{-i},σ_{-i})(y_i) − CRPS_empiricalLOO(y_i)] ≥ 0.5. Same numbers as CRPS_KILL_MIN_N / CRPS_KILL_MIN_IMPROVEMENT. Report the paired mean and its SE, not two unpaired means.

LOOKED AFTER THE LINE WAS IN THE SOURCE. Synthetic NFL-shaped draws from nflKeyNumberMixture (n=400, σ=14, seed 17): meanD = 0.012, SE = 0.014, z = 0.90, verdict gaussian_not_killed. n=50 is underpowered, as registered. The key-number bump is wrong by construction and not wrong enough to matter at 0.5 CRPS points on this synthetic. Unpaired means (7.23 vs 7.24) would have hidden the SE.

MISSING INPUT, NAMED. TeamGameLog.teamScore / opponentScore (or nflverse games.csv home/away) via marginsFromTeamGameRecords. This sandbox does not hold those rows. sampleKind is synthetic-nfl-shaped. Not a production number.

The ranking mill (compareNflKeyNumberVsGaussian) still shows the diagnostic is BLIND to the bump (Gaussian ties, discrete A wins). That is a ranking disagreement, not a 0.5-point CRPS kill. Both facts stand.
